newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhstan to keep limits on foreign T-bill buying.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan to keep limits on foreign T-bill buying.

text.p: Foreign interest in buying Kazakh Treasury bills (GKOs) is rising, but the government is not planning to increase the share of overseas investors in T-bill auctions, a senior government official said on Tuesday.

"Since the start of this year we have witnessed a huge interest of foreigners in buying Kazakh GKOs," Daniar Abulgazin, Deputy Chairman of the Treasury, told Reuters in an interview in the Kazakh capital Almaty.

Abulgazin said the successful placement of Kazakh debut Eurobonds on international financial markets last year, the tight and realistic 1997 state budget and austere credit and monetary policies stood behind the increased interest.

The government, which held the first T-bill auction in April 1994, when there were only a few cautious buyers and yields averaged some 300 percent annual, says it has managed to set up a viable state securities market and attract foreign investors.
But foreigners are entitled to buy only 15 percent of each three-month GKO issue and 30 percent of six- and 12-month issues.

"We have a mixed attitude to foreigners' interest -- on the one hand, their active participation in auctions brings down yields on GKOs, and this can't help making us happy, but we should also think of domestic investors," Abulgazin said.

At an auction of the six-month paper on Monday the yield fell to 25.28 percent annual from 26.27 percent at the previous auction on March 4. The results of the three-month GKO auction held on Tuesday are expected to be made public on Wednesday.
Foreign demand for GKOs at the last few auctions has been as high as 150-200 percent of the issues on offer, despite the limites on foreign participation, Abulgazin said.

"If we lift the limits imposed on foreign participation, not a single Kazakh bank will be able to take part in GKO auctions, and this will affect the liquidity of the balance of local banks," he said.
